about: F-18 §23 item 6: 20 driver questions. `words` is what the driver said (the last final transcript); `query` is what she would send to web_search before the app's §19 date rewrite; `previous` is the turn before a follow-up (the app sends only the last transcript, so it is not sent). Fill `reference` on the day of the run, as `reference_source` says.
